decisions.reason: Extensive sunk costs in the multi-model line and its closeness to the firm's core heat-exchanger offer make withdrawal unlikely despite no new results.
The product's established major market share and strong fit with the core business leave almost no reason to drop it.
Like Product A, the multi-model line represents significant investment and public commitment, so escalation of commitment keeps it on the market.
Its dedicated website page signals visible public commitment, and its role as a core component supports persistence.
The firm's visible commitment via its own page and the product's centrality to heat-exchanger innovation favor keeping it.
